semantics.reaction_eligibility: Only fresh calibrated C0 E ability parent chains admitted by App; weapon Swirl is not equivalent to an ability reaction.
semantics.provider_presence: Ordinary ability Swirl may trigger on or off field; onAdded.doOffStage is not a listener foreground filter.
semantics.fixed_stat_view: Raw NONEXTRA_ELEMENT_MASTERY reads ordinary em only under an explicit fixed-panel equality declaration; all potential provider EM writes remain unsupported.
semantics.sampling: Read provider EM on reaction trigger, freeze that value for the instance; beneficiary dmg_bonus belongs to self domain and obeys its own snapshot.
semantics.unique_replace: RemoveUniqueModifier then ApplyModifier becomes one single-provider single-layer refresh; later values replace earlier values, not max. Different elements are independent.
semantics.targets: Single-player fixed team inside the raw party predicate range; ordinary single Monster origin inside raw listener range. Units are not inferred.
semantics.initial_state: No existing source instances and no recipient panel already contains this conditional bonus, explicitly declared.
semantics.dynamic_lifecycle: Fixed party/equipment/progression and no external remove/recover/state-change or hitlag effects; general lifecycle remains unsupported.
semantics.partial_scope: Only ordinary hydro/cryo branches projected; fire/electro/Star branches and propagation remain recorded but unsupported.
